confirmation_target_receipt.eligibility: both teams have >=8 prior completed identities strictly before target calendar date; same-date eligibility assessed before same-date updates

training_source.training_population: all C077-A eligible completed pre-2024 rows with realized exact T>=7

baseline.family: exact-T pooled Dirichlet-smoothed empirical P(H|T) from frozen pre-2024 training tail only

candidate.fit: expand each frozen pre-2024 high-tail training match into T Bernoulli goal-allocation trials, H successes and T-H failures
candidate.pipeline: SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=2000, class_weight=null, random_state=0)

external_feature_transport.confirmation_numeric_values_materialized: only for the frozen 6943 eligible target identities, after all preflight gates pass
external_feature_transport.history_updates: only prior frozen eligible identities contribute score-history features, matching C077-A result_events over eligible identities
external_feature_transport.league_history_key: competition_family + league-series token derived from frozen source filename after stripping season/year prefix and .txt, e.g. czech-republic/cz1 versus czech-republic/cz2
external_feature_transport.same_day_rule: all fixtures on a calendar date receive feature snapshots from history strictly before that date; no same-date result updates occur until every same-date snapshot is frozen
external_feature_transport.mean_definition: arithmetic mean over prior eligible results
external_feature_transport.missing_history: NaN passed to the frozen training-fitted median imputer; no external-domain refit
external_feature_transport.count_features: log1p of prior eligible result-history count for home and away teams
external_feature_transport.exact_total: conditioning variable T for the target row; used only after numeric label open because the estimand is P(D|T,X)

numeric_score_open_rule.precondition: source count/SHA and eligible count/SHA must be regenerated exactly from zero-label metadata before any score integer conversion
numeric_score_open_rule.parser: for an eligible fixture line, decode the first full-time score token after the fixture identity and before any parenthesized auxiliary score; league-only files are frozen to avoid knockout extra-time ambiguity

coverage_gate_before_scoring.failure_decision: STOP_COVERAGE_CONFIRMATION_LABELS_CONSUMED; do not score candidate vs baseline; do not replace identities or lower gates

domain_replication_rule.eligible_domain_for_majority_vote: frozen competition family with at least 5 realized T>=7 scored rows
domain_replication_rule.strict_majority_definition: number of eligible domains with mean candidate-minus-baseline LogLoss <0 must be strictly greater than half of eligible domains

metrics.primary: conditional exact-D LogLoss; scored equivalently on legal home-goal H support because D=2H-T is one-to-one at fixed T

all_required: paired bootstrap 90% upper bound for pooled dLogLoss <0
at least 3 eligible competition domains for majority vote
strict majority of eligible competition domains have dLogLoss <0
frozen_confirmation_pass_gate.decision: CONFIRMATION_PASS only if every required gate passes; otherwise CONFIRMATION_FAIL_PARK
